system.description: This heavy-duty suit can almost be considered a miniature spaceship. It appears as a large metallic ovoid with jointed, servo-assisted arms and legs. It increases Vigor pool by 1 and inflicts an extra 1d10 damage in melee. Its miniature plasma thrusters are capable of delivering 0.01 g for 10 hours. Like all hardsuits, it is environmentally sealed, protecting you from vacuum, radiation, and temperatures from –175 to 140 C, and self-seals any punctures that inflict less than 30 points of damage.
